author: John Gruber
description:
Sumathi Reddy, writing for The Wall Street Journal (gift link):

The U.S.’s loss of what is known as measles-elimination status is a massive public-health defeat that begs a question: How long will it take to regain it?

Based on other countries’ experience it could be up to five years, say doctors and epidemiologists. But that assumes the federal government is a robust and willing participant proactively working on measles vaccination.

Without that, it could take even longer.

Nilay Patel, in the headline of his endorsement of Kamala Harris two years ago: “A Vote for Donald Trump Is a Vote for School Shootings and Measles”.
title: The U.S. — Utterly Predictably — Has Lost Measles Elimination Status Under Trump and RFK Jr.

author: John Gruber
description:
Apple Support:

Starting with the 2027 software releases, Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features are available for free for users with a supported device set to a supported language. Some features rely on powerful server models and have limits where increased access is available with eligible iCloud+ plans, starting with the 27.3 release. These include, but aren’t limited to, features in these categories:

  • Siri AI
  • Images: Intelligent Photo Editing Tools including Clean Up, Extend, and Spatial Reframing, and Image Playground
  • Workflows and automation: AFM Cloud and Cloud Pro models in Shortcuts
  • Third-party apps using Apple Foundation Models in Private Cloud Compute

[...]
